system.description:
Mark a Stress to turn Spectral until you
make an action against other creature.
While Spectral, your body is wrapped
in active camouflage, signal chaff, and
predictive movement software. You are
Hidden, you don’t trigger mundane
cameras or alarms, and you can’t be
directly targeted by physical attacks
unless a creature is within Melee range
or the GM spends a Fear to reveal you.
While Spectral, you can bypass
cameras, laser grids, and other
security-controlled barriers as though
you had the proper access. This
doesn’t allow you to pass through solid
walls or barriers with no plausible entry
point.
Other creatures might still see brief
signs of your passage.
